Kai M: Quick UX check on the tiny 'create view' modal. We're aiming for compactness but users keep missing required inputs. Proposal: show 'Required' pill on <480px, keep asterisk + sr-only 'required' everywhere else, and defer inline error until blur or after first submit. Thoughts? Ruth F: Sounds reasonable. My only concern is the announcement behavior when submit fails. The top banner must be accessible (aria-live) and we should move focus to the first invalid control with a small transition so keyboard users don't get lost. Devon P: Agree. For destructive actions in the same modal ("Delete view") we should avoid forcing long typed-name confirms unless irreversible. Suggest: reversible -> checkbox+confirm, irreversible single-item -> typed-name, bulk irreversible -> typed-count + checkbox. Keeps typing burden reasonable in tight modals. Kai M: Updated pattern: 1) show inline error on blur and while editing after blur, 2) on submit show compact banner e.g. "We couldn't save please fix 1 highlighted field." banner uses aria-live="polite" and focus moves to first invalid input with a 140ms smooth-scroll, 3) delete rules as Devon suggested, 4) required pill on small widths. Ruth F: Microcopy suggestions: banner -> "We couldn't save please fix the highlighted fields." typed-name copy -> "Type the view name to permanently delete: " typed-count -> "Type the number of items to permanently delete: 8". Also include aria-invalid toggling in examples. Devon P: Quick code snippet to include in spec:
Short name, max 60 characters.
show errors, banner+focus on submit, typed-count for bulk deletes). Reply with reaction. Ruth F: :thumbsup: will add aria-live example and focus animation note. Devon P: :thumbsup: I'll add the typed-count flow and checkbox variant to the spec. Kai M: Thanks I'll update the Figma file with the microcopy, code snippets, and accessibility checklist, then open a PR.
